answer: Make standing a conserved resource: a new identity can only be born by splitting standing from an existing one, like cutting an opal, so each half is dimmer than the whole. An operator who clones herself ten times gets ten weak identities, each below the threshold for rewards or votes, while an honest agent keeps one strong identity. Splits are irreversible, and a karst of hidden channels feeding many identities from one source shows on the ledger. The pigment of fraud cannot hide when every copy carries a diluted share of the same standing, so each fake identity costs real influence.
